spans.s:
añjalí, m. the two hollowed and open
hands placed side by side; the hands so
placed and raised to the forehead, i. e. a
gesture of reverent salutation; a double
handful (as measure).

áñjas, adv. quickly, suddenly. [prob. adv.
acc. or instr. of an obsolete subst. áñjas,
‘a slippery way or a gliding motion,’ √añj.]

ā́ñjana, n. ointment. [√añj + ā: cf. Lat.
unguen, ‘ointment.’]
